connector.name: ClawTerminal
connector.registryDescription: Ask your AI about the markets: filings, insider & congress trades, fund flows, options, macro
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.clawterminal.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.clawterminal, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: Bearer API key (Bearer sk-live-...). Get one at https://clawterminal.ai/setup
